resources.string: Divide the selected percentage by 100 to get the converted fraction. Multiply the starting amount by that fraction to get the converted amount. Subtract the converted amount from the starting amount to get the remaining precursor.

Chief cells in gastric glands release an inactive enzyme precursor. Parietal cells supply acid, creating an environment that helps the precursor convert to its active form. The model divides a fictional starting amount into converted and remaining shares, both in model units (MU). The selected percentage is not a measure of acidity or enzyme activity. This model is for teaching only and does not predict digestion or stomach emptying.
